messages.subject: proposal: 2FA mandatory, deadline Apr 3
messages.body:
Proposal, after last month's exercise:

- 2FA becomes mandatory on all staff accounts — email, Git host, cloud consoles, admin panels — not just the ones it is currently optional on.
- Deadline: Friday 3 April. Hard deadline, not aspirational. Accounts without 2FA after that date lose access, no exceptions, mine included.
- Method: authenticator app (TOTP) as the baseline. SMS is not acceptable as a method — it is the weakest link dressed up as security.
- Hardware keys: I would like them for the four of us with production access; roughly €50 each, so under Helen's no-drama threshold.

After the key episode, the cheapest possible insurance against the next one is making stolen passwords alone useless. This is the cheapest such insurance on the market.

Cheers,
Dev
Dev Raman | CTO | Parcelwise B.V.

messages.subject: re: proposal: 2FA mandatory, deadline Apr 3
messages.body:
fine with it, one condition: we buy real hardware keys for prod access, not totp for the people who can drop the database. a phone app on the same phone that gets the sms codes is not a second factor in any meaningful sense.

also someone should write the setup doc before the deadline, not after. last password policy rollout half the company locked themselves out on day one.

messages.subject: RE: proposal: 2FA mandatory, deadline Apr 3
messages.body:
👍 hardware keys for the four, jonas is right.

Sent from my iPhone

messages.subject: RE: proposal: 2FA mandatory, deadline Apr 3
messages.body:
Hallo all,

Practical bits from my side:

- I will send the step-by-step setup instructions to everyone on Monday morning, with screenshots for the authenticator apps. Jonas: the doc will exist before the deadline 😊
- I will order 6 hardware keys today (4 + 2 spare) and chase anyone who has not enabled 2FA by 27 March, so the last week is not a panic.
- I will keep a simple checklist of who is done where, and send Dev a short status on 1 and 3 April.

Danke,
Lena

messages.subject: RE: proposal: 2FA mandatory, deadline Apr 3
messages.body:
Hi Lena,

Sorry to bother — could the Monday instructions include a note for people who switch phones often? Mine is two years old and I've been meaning to replace it, and I don't want to lock myself out of everything the week I do. Sorry if that's a silly question, happy to figure it out myself if it's covered in the standard docs.

Ravi
